_comment: Umpan panel 'What's new' di halaman login (tampil hanya saat masa trial). Tambah entri baru di paling atas array. Nilai type: feature | improvement | fix. Hapus berkas ini atau matikan TRIAL_MODE untuk menyembunyikan panel.
trial_note: Trial build — documents created in this app are written to the SAP trial company (LAB_SBO_20260924), not to production.

updates.title: Procurement register now reads PR and PO from SAP
updates.summary: Purchase requests and purchase orders for Plant and Logistics & Warehouse are pulled from SAP every 15 minutes, with document headers and item lines kept in sync (re-running the sync never duplicates a line).

updates.title: Creating PR/PO in SAP fixed
updates.summary: Document submission to SAP never worked before: the PR payload was missing its required date field and PO lines were sent without item numbers. Both are fixed and verified end to end against the SAP trial company.

updates.title: Part prices come from SAP
updates.summary: Every part number is priced from SAP: last purchase order first, then the item master, then this app's own request history — always with the source and the reference number shown next to the price.

updates.title: Budget ceiling is set per project per month
updates.summary: The Finance Director now sets one ceiling per project per period (instead of one per equipment unit). Saving the same period again is recorded as a revision, with the old amount reversed in the ledger.

updates.title: Project context selector in the header
updates.summary: Accounts without a fixed project can switch project from the header; the choice applies to every page, including Daily Monitoring. Accounts tied to one project stay locked to it.

updates.title: Interface fully in English
updates.summary: All screens, validation messages, reports and role names are in English. Money is still formatted Indonesian style (Rp 1.234.567,00) because the ledger is in IDR.

updates.title: Sidebar follows the page you are on
updates.summary: The sidebar now highlights the active page and opens its submenu (Reports, Admin) instead of always highlighting Dashboard.

updates.title: Procurement lifecycle after the PO
updates.summary: Approved requests can create their PR in SAP, goods receipt is recorded with the GRPO number and date, and every request shows a procurement history card (MR / PR / PO / GRPO).

updates.title: Dashboard with real figures per role
updates.summary: Approvers see pending decisions, planners see their project's ceiling, committed and remaining amounts, drawn from the same numbers as the Budget page.

updates.title: Reports with PDF and CSV download
updates.summary: Budget consumption, vendor performance and equipment cost reports can be downloaded as PDF or CSV. The download is permission-gated: without the right role the button is not shown and the URL is refused.

updates.title: Budget engine: cancellations and goods receipt
updates.summary: A cancelled request now releases its committed budget, and a goods receipt no longer counts the amount twice (commitment plus actual).

updates.title: Access limits per role
updates.summary: Drafts can only be created by planner and mechanic; governance pages (Approvals, Tabulation Bid, Overbudget, Cancellation, Interchange) are only reachable by the roles that act on them, and the menu hides the rest.

updates.title: Daily monitoring improvements
updates.summary: Status changes to Breakdown require a note, and the unit list can be searched, filtered by status or project, and paged (25 / 50 / 100 rows).
